name: What happens after the damaged shingle assessment is completed?

mainEntity.name: What happens after the damaged shingle assessment is completed?

acceptedAnswer.text: After the damaged shingle assessment, our inspector will provide a detailed report outlining the findings, including photos of the damage. We will then discuss the recommended solutions, which may involve minor repairs, partial shingle replacement, or a full roof replacement, depending on the severity. We provide a transparent quote for any recommended work and can guide you through the next steps, including insurance claim assistance if applicable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Following the assessment, you'll receive a detailed report with findings, recommended solutions, and a transparent quote for any necessary work.
